full_prompt_en: A square high-contrast anime illustration shows a young swordsman lunging before a white circle on a flat red ground. The background is a saturated brick-red field, nearly unmodulated except for a darker cast shape beneath the figure. A large rough-edged cream disk sits behind the head and shoulders, slightly above the center, and makes the black hair and raised arms stand out. The swordsman fills the middle of the frame in a deep crouch, one leg bent close to the body and the other stepping toward the lower edge. Tousled black hair with red-brown touches rises around the face. Dark brows and sharply focused eyes look straight ahead, while a small red mark cuts across the pale forehead. A dark high-collared uniform with round buttons is crossed by a bold black-and-white checkered outer garment. The checker pattern breaks around sleeves and torso as the cloth lifts in the movement. Loose red trousers fold in angular masses over wrapped lower legs, and dark footwear with red straps anchors the lower center. At the right, a long dark sword extends diagonally from the hand toward the edge; smaller broken red and black marks radiate near the body. The drawing uses crisp ink silhouettes, brushlike broken accents, and broad flat colors rather than graded realistic surfaces. The strongest light seems to come from the white disk behind the character, giving a hard contrast around head and shoulders, while the forward face and clothing are organized by pale reserved shapes and dark shadows. The overall composition is urgent and graphic, using a central forward thrust, circular backplate, and strict red-black-white palette to concentrate action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高对比动漫插画呈现一名年轻剑士，在平坦红底的白色圆盘前纵身前冲。背景是一片饱和砖红色域，除人物下方一块较深的投影形状外几乎没有渐层。头肩后方中央稍上的奶油白大圆盘边缘粗糙，使黑发和扬起手臂突出。剑士以深蹲姿态占据画面中央，一条腿贴近身体屈起，另一条向下缘踏出。蓬乱黑发间有红棕触色，围在面孔四周。深眉与锐利集中的眼睛正望前方，浅色额头上划过一道小红痕。带圆纽扣的深色高领制服外罩大胆黑白棋盘格上衣。衣布在运动中掀起，棋盘纹随袖子和身体转折而断开。宽松红裤以棱角大褶盖住缠带的小腿，带红色绊带的深鞋扎在下方中央。右边，一把长深色剑从手中斜向画边伸出；较小红黑断痕从身体附近放射。绘制使用清脆墨色剪影、刷绘般断续重音与宽阔平涂色，而非渐进的写实表面。最强的光似乎来自人物身后的白圆盘，在头肩周围形成坚硬对比；正面面孔和衣服则由预留浅色形与深影组织。整体构图紧迫且富图形性，以中央向前的冲势、圆形背板和严格红黑白色板凝聚动作。
style_prompt_en: The graphic anime treatment limits itself to broad flat red, near-black ink, and warm off-white with only tiny muted gray accents. A large light circular field cuts into the solid ground, providing an immediate value anchor for a compact, angular foreground form. Sharp silhouettes and high-contrast patterned blocks make motion readable, while rough dry-brush splinters break selected edges. Long diagonals drive into and out of the center, countered by the stable circle behind them. Lighting is poster-like: white reserves and hard black shadows replace gradual modeling, giving the surface a screen-printed clarity. Repeated small dark and light cells create local rhythm against much larger unbroken color areas. The overall effect is fierce and economical, with crisp character design, broken ink energy, and disciplined negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种图形性动漫处理把色域限制在宽阔平坦红色、近黑墨色与暖灰白，仅有极少低调灰色重音。大片浅色圆域切入实色底，为紧凑棱角的前景形体提供立即可见的明度锚点。锋利剪影和高对比纹样块让动作可读，粗糙干笔碎痕打断选定边缘。长斜线穿入并穿出中心，由身后稳定圆形对抗。照明近似海报：白色预留和坚硬黑影替代渐进塑形，赋予表面丝网印刷般的清晰度。重复的小块明暗单元对照更大的连续色面，形成局部节奏。整体效果猛烈而节制，兼有清脆具象设计、破碎墨迹能量与严格留白。
theme_en: A swordsman lunging before a white circle on a flat red ground
theme_zh: 剑士在平坦红底的白色圆盘前纵身前冲
name: Demon Slayer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
